content.value_statement: Unread inboxes make important messages difficult to identify quickly. This skill provides a read-only summary with sender, subject, date, and optional labels.
actual_capabilities: Lists unread Gmail messages in a concise summary.
Shows each message sender, subject, and date.
Filters messages with a Gmail search query.
Includes Gmail label names when requested.
Supports table output and shared structured output formats.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and configured Google Workspace authentication.
Does not modify, archive, label, or mark messages as read.
Shows summary fields instead of full message bodies.
Search results depend on Gmail query syntax and account permissions.

use_cases.title: Review a Personal Inbox
use_cases.description: Scan unread senders and subjects before opening Gmail.

use_cases.title: Find Priority Messages
use_cases.description: Filter unread mail from a manager, customer, or project group.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Support Handoff
use_cases.description: Create a labeled summary of unread support messages for shift review.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Unread Mail
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my unread Gmail messages with sender, subject, and date.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with the default unread inbox summary.

prompt_templates.scenario: Review a smaller set of unread messages.

prompt_templates.scenario: Focus triage on a specific sender.

output_examples.output: A table lists unread messages with sender, subject, and date columns.

output_examples.input: Show five unread messages from my manager with labels.
output_examples.output: Up to five matching messages appear with sender, subject, date, and label names.

output_examples.input: Summarize unread messages matching a Gmail project query.
output_examples.output: Only messages matching the supplied Gmail search query appear in the summary.

best_practices: Start with the default summary before applying narrower Gmail queries.
Use --max to keep large inbox reviews concise.
Request labels when mailbox categories affect prioritization.
anti_patterns: Do not expect this skill to modify message state or mailbox labels.
Do not request full message bodies when summary fields are sufficient.
Do not use broad queries when sensitive sender details are unnecessary.

faq.question: Does this skill change my mailbox?
faq.answer: No. The documented triage command is read-only and does not modify messages.

faq.question: Which messages appear by default?
faq.answer: The skill defaults to unread messages using the Gmail is:unread query.

faq.question: Can I limit the number of results?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the --max flag. The documented default is 20 messages.

faq.question: Can I filter messages by sender?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply a Gmail search expression through the --query flag.

faq.question: Can the summary include labels?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the --labels flag to include label names.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install the gws CLI and follow the shared skill instructions for authentication and global flags.
